title: Postpartum Exercise
meta_desc: Returning to the gym safely after having a baby in NZ, focusing on postpartum recovery timeline, pelvic floor health, and gym options with crèche facilities.
intro: After giving birth, it's essential for new mothers in New Zealand to prioritise their health and wellbeing. According to the New Zealand Ministry of Health, regular exercise can help with postpartum recovery and reduce the risk of depression. However, it's crucial to follow a safe and gradual return to exercise to avoid any complications.

sections.heading: Postpartum Recovery Timeline
sections.body: The postpartum recovery period is typically divided into several stages. The initial stage, which lasts around 6-8 weeks, is crucial for allowing the body to heal. During this time, it's recommended to focus on gentle exercises such as pelvic floor exercises, deep breathing, and short walks. Research suggests that women who engage in regular physical activity during the postpartum period tend to have better physical and mental health outcomes.
list: 6-8 weeks: Gentle exercises like pelvic floor exercises and short walks
3-6 months: Gradually introduce more intense exercises like swimming or cycling
6 months+: Return to high-intensity exercises like running or weightlifting

sections.heading: Pelvic Floor Health
sections.body: Many gyms in New Zealand offer classes and programmes specifically designed for new mothers, which often include pelvic floor exercises. For example, Contours offers a gentle exercise programme for new mothers, which focuses on strengthening the core and pelvic floor muscles.

sections.heading: Gyms with Crèche Facilities
sections.body: For many new mothers, finding a gym with crèche facilities is essential. Gyms like YMCA and Les Mills offer crèche services, allowing mothers to exercise while their children are being cared for. Exercise NZ's subsidised gym scheme can also help make gym memberships more affordable, with discounts of up to 70% off.
list: YMCA: Offers crèche facilities at many of its locations
Les Mills: Provides crèche services at select clubs
Contours: Gentle exercise programme for new mothers

sections.heading: Getting Started
